# Monopolises

Monopolises is a governed research project testing strategic replaceability.

Current status: Gate 0 open. The category thesis is not yet ratified.

Canonical public pages:
- https://monopolises.com/
- https://monopolises.com/thesis/
- https://monopolises.com/methodology/
- https://monopolises.com/sources/
- https://monopolises.com/research/
- https://monopolises.com/about/

Core working proposition:
Power is the time it takes to replace you.

Important boundary:
Monopolises does not infer legal monopoly status, wrongdoing, or market dominance from replacement difficulty. It does not publish replacement scores before the evidence method is validated.
